messages:
Nina R: Kicking off onboarding for Paloma pilot tomorrow 9am PT. Need owners for integration, enablement, and renewal milestones. Keeping this thread as async runbook.

Omar V: I can own infra + SSO. Blocker: customer requires audit log forwarding to their Splunk instance. Need contact + IP ranges.

Celia M: I'll handle CS cadence and success criteria. From PM: 1) SSO working E2E; 2) latency p95 <250ms; 3) demo flow completed by customer engineers. Renewal risk medium if not live in 6 weeks.

Ethan B: Enablement plan: two 45m sessions (Dev setup, App demo). Propose Wed 4/19 10am PT and Fri 4/21 1pm PT.

Ravi P: Security asks: SOC2 attestation + DPA. Also KMS integration doc. I'll prepare a short packet and link it to the ticket.

OnboardBot: Ticket created: CS-4890 - Paloma pilot onboarding (https://tracker.redwood.dev/CS-4890) assigned to Nina R, Omar V, Celia M.

Maya C: I'll send calendar invites and a pre-meeting checklist requesting SAML metadata, test user, IP ranges, and three sample prompts for quality checks.

Nina R: Action items: Omar get IP ranges + Splunk contact; Ethan confirm enablement slots; Ravi upload security packet to CS-4890; Celia add renewal milestones to Notion. Daily async updates in this thread during integration window.
